summary.released_energy_method: trapezoidal integral of sampled instantaneous gas-phase HRR

warnings: Exploratory FDS 6.11.1 calculation; not calibrated or validated against NASA microgravity experiments.
Coarse LES grid and mixing-controlled gas chemistry cannot establish microgravity flame extinction limits.
Ventilation exchanges fresh ambient gas with external reservoirs; it is not a closed recirculating spacecraft HVAC loop.
Soot is a prescribed reaction yield; CO toxicity, battery runaway, arcs and plasma are not modeled.

sampling.method: FDS cell values at gas-only DEVC points; velocity components use nearest staggered cell faces

provenance.note: Dry-wood first-stage TGA tutorial parameters; char is inert here. Heat of combustion 16 MJ/kg and constant gas Cp 1.5 kJ/(kg K) are explicit illustrative assumptions. This is neither pure cellulose kinetics nor BASS SIBAL fabric calibration.
